page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 24 physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, ensuring dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading.

This instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The balanced resource allocation of the ecs.g6.6xlarge makes it suitable for general-purpose workloads such as medium-sized databases, enterprise applications, web serving, and containerized microservices. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance primarily for standard compute and memory tasks that rely on network-attached storage.
